lessons.claim: Korean can be load-bearing as DATA, not just as matched prose. The RENAMED dict in verify_1c_equivalence.py maps old metrics.json keys to new ones, and the old keys are literal Korean strings inside a frozen archive: measured, 9 archived runs carry 81 such keys under 'dimensionless' and RENAMED resolves 75 of them. Translating those keys would stop them matching, so each field would be reported as DELETED -- 75 false violations. runs/ is non-reproducible so the keys cannot be migrated either. Before translating any string used as a dict key or a lookup into runs/ or specs/, count how many archived records it resolves against.
